traditional: the Sun trine Jupiter: a soft contact. Vitality, authority, and recognition supports growth, fortune, and patronage — cooperation and favorable conditions in these areas.
modern: Identity meets optimism, expansion, and luck. Confidence to venture and a sense that the odds will cooperate. The trine makes this a natural strength: Genuine confidence and opportunity; doors open more readily. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

cyclic.waxing: Selfhood and growth flow together with ease; respond to the opportunity.
cyclic.waning: Distribute and give transmissible form to what selfhood and growth have realized.

business: An opening in this area. Confidence and opportunity, with overextension as the standing risk.
shadow: The ease lets egotism and needing to be the center and excess and overreach go unchecked, or the opening pass unused.
arcApplying: Ease and support build and arrive on their own.
arcSeparating: The ease withdraws; the flow passes, used or not.
